claim: Make CB.Belief.Store.read directory-aware: when the configured graph path resolves to a per-belief directory, glob and parse <ns>/<local>.json sorted by id; keep the single-file array as fallback for unsplit collections. The prototype proved the loaded graph byte-identical to the single-file load.

evidence.detail: Discharged 2026-07-06: Store.read is directory-aware - a directory path loads one node per <local>.json file sorted naturally by id (b1000 after b999, settling the digit-rollover hazard), a .json path keeps the single-file array as the fallback for unsplit collections, and CB.Config's default resolves to beliefs/cb once the split exists. Layout equivalence covered by test (the same collection loads identically from either layout).
